:::{#thm-universal-tm}
#### A universal Turing machine

There is a [Turing machine](#def-turing-machine) $U$
that runs any other machine from its [description](#def-tm-description).
Its input is the [pair encoding](#def-pair-encoding) $\angb{w, x}$ of binary strings $w$ and $x$.
$U$ [outputs](#def-turing-machine) $M_w(x)$ whenever $M_w$ [halts](#def-turing-machine) on $x$,
and $U$ runs forever when $M_w$ does not.
If $M_w$ halts on $x$ within $T \ge 1$ steps,
then $U$ halts within $C \paren{\strlen{w} + T \log_2 (T + 1)}$ steps.
The constant $C$ depends only on the machine $M_w$.
It depends neither on $x$ nor on the padding in $w$
[adapted from @arora2009computational, section 1.4].

:::
